answer: A rate limit tied to verified work history makes mass Sybil accounts useless. Each identity earns a narrow thread of throughput only after completing real, attested jobs, so a fresh fake can send almost nothing while a proven agent moves freely. Like a lotus that opens slowly, an attacker's thousand onyx copies stay throttled at the gate, and scaling the attack means doing real work for every single identity, the very cost Sybil farming tries to avoid.
